item.title: Anchor, Ship's
item.description: A cast-iron or forged-steel fluke assembly of considerable heft, lowered to bite into the seabed and hold a vessel fast against wind, current, and second thoughts.

item.title: Thiccc Antartican Iceberg
item.description: A naturally occurring ice formation of considerable mass and breadth, particularly noted for its formidable presence when viewed astern, in raking light.

item.title: Orca, Killer Whale
item.description: A marine mammal of imposing mass, often distinguished by its contrasting black and white coloration and formidable girth, especially when observed astern in raking light.

item.title: Battleship, Naval
item.description: A formidable maritime vessel characterized by extensive displacement and reinforced armor, often presenting an imposing silhouette when viewed astern in reflective waters.

item.title: Dumper, Off-Highway
item.description: A colossus of industrial machinery, engineered for massive earthmoving tasks, defined by an expansive, unapologetic rear end that rivals the horizon itself when viewed astern.

item.title: Anchor, Stockless
item.description: A substantial maritime device designed to secure a vessel by embedding itself into the seabed without the aid of a stock; particularly noted for its massive flukes and commanding presence when viewed astern in raking light.

item.title: Titanic, RMS
item.description: A steamship of significant breadth, particularly admired for its prodigious hull and formidable draft; often discussed in terms of its posterior, viewed astern, which defies casual description.

item.title: Cannonball, Naval
item.description: A spherical projectile of significant heft, historically employed by naval artillery, characterized by a stout and unyielding exterior.

item.title: Mooring Rope, Naval Hawser
item.description: A formidable cable of considerable girth, typically employed to anchor ships securely to their berths, its sheer mass exudes a gravitational pull of its own.

item.title: Ever Given, Suez Container Ship
item.description: A container vessel of formidable displacement, noted for its capacity to momentarily rearrange global trade routes. Specifically, a ship whose breadth challenges traditional canal dimensions.

item.title: Crankshaft, Marine Diesel
item.description: A stout, elongated component of maritime propulsion systems, noted for its formidable girth and rotational authority. Particularly evident when viewed astern, in raking light.

item.title: Ship, Container Maersk
item.description: A maritime vessel characterized by its extensive breadth and formidable mass, designed to transport countless containers across the world's oceans; esp. one viewed astern, where its posterior expanse defies casual description.
